Closed helper, reset viewport, selected normal Back to the road from the paused menu and waited for the glide to settle. Final screenshot showed 0 km/h on a clear road with 901 m routed pickup distance. No further drive was attempted.
Paused, marked the accepted order as a handoff, read empty warn/error logs and script asset, and released the input lock. Other game tabs were untouched.
